title: `CORR`: shared Welford state; NULL for one pair or zero variance
verdict: ck / sqrt(xMk · yMk); NULL as in the reference; no clamp
description: One shared Welford state (`ck`, `xMk`, `yMk`); the result is `ck / sqrt(xMk * yMk)`. One pair is NULL (NaN under `spark.sql.legacy.statisticalAggregate`); `xMk == 0` or `yMk == 0` is NULL. Not clamped to [-1, 1].
If `xMk * yMk` underflows to 0 with neither side 0, the division raises under ANSI mode (the 4.x default) and gives NULL otherwise.
reference: `AggFn.corr` (`corrOf`): NULL for fewer than two pairs, or for a side whose values are all equal; else the co-deviation sum by the square root of the product of the two squared-deviation sums. It is not clamped to [-1, 1]. Engines may differ in the last bits (#54) until #85 bounds the error.
